goal_text: Generate a 10-file documentation site for Courier to prove multi-worker orchestration.

workflow_plan.instruction: Create docs/public_site/index.md containing a welcome message for the Courier project.
Create docs/public_site/setup.md containing a setup guide for the Courier project.
Create docs/public_site/api.md containing an overview of the Courier central API.
Create docs/public_site/architecture.md containing a description of the Mac and Windows worker architecture.
Create docs/public_site/billing.md containing a placeholder guide for billing and token limits.
Create docs/public_site/faq.md containing 3 frequently asked questions about Courier.
Create docs/public_site/contributing.md containing guidelines for contributing to Courier.
Create docs/public_site/security.md containing the security policies for Courier (e.g., bypassing sandbox, exact process ownership).
Create docs/public_site/release_notes.md containing release notes for version 1.0.
Read the docs/public_site directory and create a docs/public_site/site_map.md linking to all 9 generated files.
